newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Malawi in talks with Gencor on bauxite.
newsitem.headline: Malawi in talks with Gencor on bauxite.

text.p: Malawi has been in contact with South Africa's Gencor Ltd on the possible use of a large bauxite deposit for alumina feedstock in Gencor's planned Mozambique aluminium smelter, Malawi's Mines Minister Dumbo Lemani said on Moday.
Lemani told reporters ahead of a sub-Saharan Oil and Minerals conference that the country was seeking backers to develop the bauxite deposit.
Asked if he had been in contact with Gencor -- which plans to erect a 1.2 billion dollar aluminium smelter north of the Mozambican capital Maputo -- Lemani said Malawi and Gencor had been in contact.
"There has been some correspondence with the people who are going to build the aluminium smelter in Mozambique," Lemani said.
